_metadata.description: React dashboard: nodes with OS/arch/version/health, pairing/revocation, live job status, run history with log/artifact drill-in.

requirements.title: Fleet Control-Plane UI
requirements.description: A React dashboard shows the fleet at a glance — nodes with OS/arch/version/health, pairing and revocation, live job status, and run history with drill-into logs/artifacts — so the owner can operate the fleet without the CLI.

validation.notes: Node list renders OS/arch/version/health with non-color-only status; pairing and revoke flows handle loading/error/empty states.
Run history streams live job output and exposes downloadable artifacts; long jobs show progress + cancel + ETA.
An operator pairs a node, dispatches a job, and watches it complete entirely from the dashboard.
